intro: A 2-Year Investor ITAS provides a longer limited stay permit for foreign investors in Indonesia. With a 2-year validity period, investors can more freely carry out investment oversight activities without needing to renew their stay permit annually. This option is more cost-effective in the long term compared to renewing a 1-year ITAS each year.

requirements.item: Original passport with minimum 18 months validity
Company deed of establishment showing applicant's shareholding
Proof of investment / company registration documents
Other identity documents as per immigration requirements

faqs.question: What is the benefit of 2-year ITAS over 1-year ITAS?
faqs.answer: The 2-year ITAS is more cost-effective in the long run. While the upfront cost is higher (Rp 18 million vs Rp 16 million for 1 year), you save on renewal processing fees and spend less time on immigration administration each year.

faqs.question: Can a 2-year ITAS be renewed again?
faqs.answer: Yes. ITAS can be renewed as long as the holder still holds active shares in a legally registered Indonesian company. Renewal should be initiated before the current ITAS expires.

faqs.question: Are the requirements for 2-year ITAS different from 1-year ITAS?
faqs.answer: The document requirements are essentially the same for both. The main difference is in the immigration fees, which are higher for the 2-year duration.

faqs.question: Can family members stay in Indonesia on 2-year ITAS?
faqs.answer: Yes. Spouse and children can apply for a Family ITAS (dependent permit) sponsored by the 2-year Investor ITAS holder, allowing the family to reside in Indonesia for the same period.

faqs.question: How long does 2-year ITAS processing take?
faqs.answer: Estimated processing time is around 2–4 working weeks after all documents are declared complete. The timeline is similar to the 1-year ITAS process.
